research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Europe-led kidswear trade fairs; premium and mid-market childrenswear, newborn to teen
title: SS27 Girls' Beach Couture
summary: Girls' summer dressing with a couture touch: romantic swimwear, sarongs and skirts, mother-daughter matching, bold reversible dresses and luxury "princess" pieces.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Marie Raxevisky's "Beach Couture" line offers UPF 50+ swimwear, sarongs and skirts in fine Italian fabrics and recycled materials, with coordinated adult and child pieces including a mother-daughter match<sup>[1]</sup>. Piccoli Principi's "Pearl & Tides" swimwear runs from vintage pink to pastel green and soft navy<sup>[1]</sup>. Poco Blush, designed "almost exclusively for girls", showed bold hues and a loose, printed, reversible dress<sup>[2]</sup>. Speranza and Junona show a luxury "princess" style<sup>[2]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Vintage pink, pastel green and soft navy; coral and lavender; red as an accent. See SS27 Kids' Season Colours.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Swimsuits and two-pieces with cover-up sarongs and skirts.
- Loose and reversible printed dresses.
- Occasion dresses with full skirts.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: UPF swim fabrics, voile, organic cotton poplin, recycled fine fabrics.

products:
- Swim and cover-up sets, sarongs, printed and reversible dresses, mother-daughter capsules.
- Customers: girls roughly 4 to 12 and their families.
design_implications:
- Keep ruffles and bows securely attached and away from the mouth area for younger girls.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Mother-daughter capsules extend the basket; price as a set.
